cycles.method: Not measured in cycles. No static bound was counted and no event was timed on the chip. What exists: the base's CPU meter, read by eye on the author's Octatrack MKI (OS 1.40C, Modwerk base built from this repository's sources, USB Audio off variant, 20 November 2026, a pattern with the tracks playing). 44 % with no Grain track. With two Grain tracks, mono, at DENS 64: 63 to 64 %. Two stereo tracks at DENS 64: 64 to 65 %. Two tracks at high density and PAN: 67 to 68 %. Two tracks with DENS and PAN at the maximum and all six grains sounding: 73 to 74 %. That is about 10 points of the meter for a track at DENS 64 and 14 to 15 with everything at the maximum. These are readings of the whole unit, stock work included, not the longest event of the module's code. The DSP and memory readings did not move. The engine itself is checked on a computer (verify.py): its optimized read paths give the same samples, byte for byte, as the plain ones.

load.method: No cfmeter.py capture and no MIDI flood: Grain has no MIDI path. It works in the frame interrupt on every frame of a sounding Grain track, so the comparison that exists is the CPU meter above, with and without Grain tracks, on the same unit and pattern. The base's frame guard counter (mw_frame_sheds) was read on the unit with the full-screen page's own debug build and did not move from 0 while two Grain tracks played.

stress.droppedExplanation: No MIDI path. Two Grain tracks played for several minutes on the author's MKI with the pattern running and parameters turned, scenes and the crossfader moved and LFOs on the SRC knobs, with no hang reported and no skipped render counted by the base's frame guard. This is the author's report, not a stress run with a fixed duration.
